release_handoff_rule: This package is the single release handoff surface for DeliveryHarnessAssets. Module facets and module rows are evidence slices only; they must not be reopened, closed, or reassigned as separate business tasks.

FishingPlayerEntry.title: Map / Input / Interaction——Fishing 玩家入口闭环
FishingPlayerEntry.status_basis: Static, Build, Automation, Lake map verification, and FullLoop evidence are recorded as one atomic player-entry closure.

UIReach.title: UI / Reach——Fishing 信息可达闭环
UIReach.status_basis: Static, Build, Automation, Runtime attach evidence, comment review, and code review are recorded as one atomic UI reachability closure.

ItemsTankSacrificeCamp.title: Items / Tank / Sacrifice / Camp——局内渔获归宿闭环
ItemsTankSacrificeCamp.status_basis: Static, Build, Automation, Lake Runtime, comment review, code review, and test-document review are recorded as one atomic fish-destination closure.

EquipmentTeamLibraryShop.title: Equipment / TeamLibrary / Shop——装备获取与装配闭环
EquipmentTeamLibraryShop.status_basis: Static, Build, Automation, Lake Runtime, comment review, and code review are recorded as one atomic equipment-acquisition-and-loadout closure.

FrontendOnline.title: Frontend / Online——前端进局与 Steam 联机闭环
FrontendOnline.status_basis: Packaged Steam two-client human playtest, UBT Build, UI Automation, Online Automation, and source-boundary inspection are recorded as one atomic frontend-online closure.

DataWorldProfileAlbum.title: Data / World / Profile / Album——长期进度与相册闭环
DataWorldProfileAlbum.status_basis: Static, Build, Automation, and comment review prove the engineering loop; formal fish/bite/fight content, concrete UnlockId milestones, and full imprint admission remain product/content blockers.

CharacterGrowthCondition.title: Character / Growth / Condition——猫身体状态与吃鱼成长闭环
CharacterGrowthCondition.status_basis: Static, Build, Automation, and Runtime evidence prove the engineering loop; formal Buff choices, visual fatigue triggers, and yellow-stamina presentation remain product/content blockers.

RunEnvironmentSocial.title: Run / Environment / Social——局阶段、环境与协作边界闭环
RunEnvironmentSocial.status_basis: Static, Build, module Automation, Lake map anchoring, Runtime, reconnect fail-closed whitelist proof, and Controller player-entry contract machine evidence now pass for the current Run, Environment, Social, GameMode, and Fishing command-component evidence batches. Command-intent phase gates, Controller Social wide-gate entrypoints, Controller Chum narrow-gate fail-closed receipt, theft owning-client result cache, legacy Fishing direct-entry fail-closed receipts, Social positive runtime enablement, success settlement policy, NaturalEvent anchoring, and reconnect admission whitelist fail-closed boundaries have machine evidence; the module remains open because necessary human or multi-client behavior evidence is not complete.

DeliveryHarnessAssets.title: Delivery / Harness / Assets——交付验证与正式资产闭环
DeliveryHarnessAssets.status_basis: Harness inventory, regression entry map, formal fish input package, formal non-fish content input package, and this release handoff are centralized; formal asset readiness remains blocked by tracked test assets, incomplete authoritative fish input, open presentation/progress/growth content decisions, and the RunEnvironmentSocial module still lacking necessary human or multi-client behavior evidence even though its Static, Build, Automation, Lake MapConfigure, Runtime, reconnect fail-closed whitelist, and Controller player-entry contract machine evidence now pass.

Runtime config still references DA_Fish_Test01, DA_Bite_Test01, and DA_Fight_Test01.
Formal UI/presentation resources and any player-visible native debug naming must stay tracked as one DeliveryHarnessAssets gap until asset readiness is closed.

Concrete UnlockId milestones, full imprint admission beyond TheftCaught, growth Buff choices, fatigue presentation triggers, and yellow-stamina presentation/consumption rules are not frozen for formal content closure.

Run / Environment / Social now has Static, Build, Automation, Lake map anchoring, Runtime evidence, reconnect fail-closed whitelist proof, and Controller player-entry contract machine proof. It remains open until one module-level human or multi-client behavior evidence item covers RunFlow, Environment, WaterQuery/Chum, Social protection/help/mischief, stealing, and reconnect fail-closed boundaries together.

evidence_contracts.warning_basis: Known external AbilitySystem warning already recorded in the module handoff; no failed, notRun, or inProcess tests are allowed.

Config/DefaultGame.ini no longer references DA_Fish_Test01, DA_Bite_Test01, or DA_Fight_Test01.
Scripts/verify_delivery_harness_assets.ps1 -Mode Static validates every evidence_contract in this package.
Formal UI/presentation resources are ready and player-visible native debug naming or raw test asset names are no longer on the formal player path.
UnlockId milestone rules, imprint admission list, growth Buff choices, visual fatigue triggers, and yellow-stamina presentation/consumption boundaries are frozen as formal product/content inputs.

RunEnvironmentSocial has its own module-level Static, Build, Automation, Runtime, reconnect fail-closed proof, and one module-level human or multi-client behavior evidence item in .codex/state/run-environment-social-behavior-evidence.json proving RunFlow, Environment, WaterQuery/Chum, Social protection/help/mischief, stealing boundaries, and reconnect fail-closed boundaries as one atomic closure; Scripts/verify_run_environment_social.ps1 -Mode BehaviorEvidence must output RUN_ENVIRONMENT_SOCIAL_BEHAVIOR_EVIDENCE_PASS.

required_facts: Frozen fish-table revision with preference bait, rarity, diet, outward segment length, rest segment length, and movement speed coefficient filled.
Per-fish UE BodyClass or model/class mapping.
Formal BitePersonalityId and FightPersonalityId assets and per-fish mappings.
Per-fish eating-effect reconciliation that can populate UCatFishDefinition without guessing.
Runtime config replacement plan that removes DA_Fish_Test01, DA_Bite_Test01, and DA_Fight_Test01 together.
do_not_do: Do not generate formal fish, bite, or fight assets from partial table rows.
Do not mark DeliveryHarnessAssets complete by only changing Config/DefaultGame.ini.

required_facts: Formal UI or presentation resources for any player-visible Lake status, menu, fish, bite, fight, and asset naming paths.
Decision that native debug text, raw state labels, and test asset names are not visible on the formal player path.
do_not_do: Do not reopen UIReach or FrontendOnline as partial presentation tasks.
Do not treat the default-hidden CatLakeReachWidget debug path as formal player UI readiness.

required_facts: Concrete world, growth, or album milestones that produce each formal equipment UnlockId.
Full imprint admission list beyond TheftCaught, including which run events can create permanent Imprint grants.
Formal growth Buff choices, numeric effects, and player-facing copy for PendingChoiceCount consumption.
Formal light, medium, and heavy fatigue presentation triggers now that fatigue is no longer a gameplay number.
Formal yellow-stamina shield presentation and consumption boundary.
do_not_do: Do not mark DataWorldProfileAlbum formally complete from engineering Profile/Collection automation alone.
Do not mark CharacterGrowthCondition formally complete from ASC/Growth automation while Buff, fatigue, or yellow-stamina content is still open.
Do not split UnlockId, imprint admission, Buff, fatigue, and yellow-stamina decisions into separate DeliveryHarnessAssets subtasks.

static_log.scope: Covers the current DeliveryReleaseHandoffPackage surface, including release evidence contracts, latest_recorded_evidence mirrored from those contracts, DeliveryHarnessAssets machine status source and its mirrored input statuses, FormalFishAssetInputPackage status mirrored from its blocking_gaps, FormalNonFishContentInputPackage package gaps and status mirrored from its content groups, completion_blockers mirrored from authoritative input states, RunEnvironmentSocial module-level remaining behavior acceptance and its single recorder, closure requirements bound to FormalFishAssetInputPackage, FormalNonFishContentInputPackage, and RunEnvironmentSocial BehaviorEvidence, remaining input contracts mirrored from the closure requirements they unblock, technical R matrix boundary marker, next RunEnvironmentSocial module marker, and human/technical remaining-input document anchors.

asset_readiness_log.scope: Covers the AssetReadiness gate: FormalFishAssetInputPackage and FormalNonFishContentInputPackage must both be ready with no package-level or content-group blocking gaps before runtime config can replace DA_Fish_Test01, DA_Bite_Test01, and DA_Fight_Test01.

latest_recorded_evidence.update_policy: Update recorded evidence only when the DeliveryReleaseHandoffPackage surface, AssetReadiness gate, or blocker state changes; do not rewrite it just because an unchanged Static rerun created a newer transcript.

close_rule: DeliveryHarnessAssets can only move from blocked to complete when FormalFishAssetInputPackage is ready, FormalNonFishContentInputPackage is ready, Config/DefaultGame.ini no longer references the tracked test assets, RunEnvironmentSocial is closed with module evidence, and the same Static plus AssetReadiness checks pass with updated release evidence.
